pattern: {o:Obj} becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness {pt:BasePT} and gains {a:Abilities} {d:Dur}
subject: object

examples.text: Target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 3/3 and gains trample until end of turn.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 1/4 and gains flying and vigilance until end of turn.

pattern: create a token that's a copy of {o:Obj}, except it's legendary
subject: none

examples.text: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact you control, except it's legendary.
Create a token that's a copy of target creature, except it's legendary.

counterExamples: Create a token that's a copy of target creature, except it isn't legendary.
